name: Server Pro
author: PyCmd
description: Makes the Servers tab a place you can work in: a live board with a health check that says whether the port really answers, restart and force-stop, a free-port finder, an index page it will write for a folder that has none, and console commands for all of it.

commands.name: restart
commands.help: restart <handle|all> - stop it and start it again

commands.name: shut
commands.help: shut <handle|all> - stop, then kill if it will not go

extends.title: Server Pro
extends.description: Live board, health checks, restart and free ports

guides.title: Using Server Pro
guides.summary: The board, health checks, restart, free ports and the commands.
